ja.title: Atomwellの学習データを読む。78%の一致率は正解率なのか
ja.summary: Datawellと人手データの10,972件中8,566件の一致から、抽出精度と選択された評価集合の違いを検討する。一致した値だけでは決まらない量を導く。
ja.seo_title: Atomwellの学習データとLLM抽出の一致率
ja.seo_description: Atomwellの公開ブログにあるDatawellとCROの照合件数を再計算。一致率78.1%を抽出精度と区別し、一致行だけの予測評価を全体へ延長する条件を数式で示す。

en.title: Reading Atomwell's training data: is 78% agreement an accuracy score?
en.summary: The reported 8,566 agreements among 10,972 matched Datawell and curated records separate extraction accuracy from selection of a validation set. Aggregate counts leave correctness unidentified.
en.seo_title: Atomwell training data and LLM extraction agreement
en.seo_description: Recalculate Datawell–CRO agreement from Atomwell's technical blog, distinguish 78.1% agreement from extraction accuracy, and derive when a selected-set comparison extends to all matched records.
